# GravelScope

> GravelScope provides free browser-based planning tools for estimating gravel quantities, weight, bags and material cost.

## Main Tool
- https://gravelscope.website/ — Gravel Calculator for cubic yards, cubic feet, tons, kilograms, bags and estimated material cost.
